title: The public /events/<slug> and /spaces/<slug> pages shared with the generic site card, because their per-entity share cards stayed in the (main) segment when the pages moved to (public)

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, two independent finders: seo-metadata and seo-social). SCAN-643 and SCAN-644 moved the event and Space profile pages under app/(public) so they can be static, but left opengraph-image.tsx (and the Space twitter-image.tsx) under app/(main)/events/[slug] and app/(main)/spaces/[slug]. A file-convention card attaches only to pages in its own segment tree, so the (public) pages inherited the root site card: every event and Space shared on iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack or X showed the generic Frequency image instead of the event cover or the Space brand. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the three card files (and the Space card's test) moved into the (public) segments; the four path references (build-fanout.test, check-event-hero-parity.test, accent-scope-coverage.test, the admin-client baseline) follow. No image logic changed.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const ok=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p);const pub=["app/(public)/events/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx","app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx"];const main=["app/(main)/events/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx","app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx"];if(!pub.every(ok)){console.error("SCAN-655: the per-entity share card is not in the (public) segment that serves /events/<slug> and /spaces/<slug>, so those pages share with the generic site card: a file-convention card attaches only to pages in its own segment tree.");process.exit(1)}if(main.some(ok)){console.error("SCAN-655: a second opengraph-image.tsx for the same URL path sits under (main): two segments cannot both serve /…/opengraph-image.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change (checked by stashing the fix); passes with it.
